crime_highlights: Mr. Brown and two others were observed stealing some rolls of commercial wire
he entered the home through an unlocked rear door and stole three laptops, a purse and some jewelry
he went into a bedroom and, there, came face-to-face with one of the tenants of the home
The tenant reported that, for a short while afterwards, she was emotionally disturbed, upset and nervous as a result of the incident
rationale_highlights: systemic and background factors provide the context within which the judge must evaluate case-specific information and determine an appropriate sentence
She specifically considered the Gladue report, including its description of systemic and background factors that affect aboriginal people and are present for Mr. Brown
she took it into account as important contextual evidence
note: Court finds Gladue considered but states no reduction in culpability or sentence.
